page.overview:
Who is Amaris?

Amaris was the firbolg husband of Trist and the father of her children during the Calamity. As an NPC, Amaris is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Amaris was a firbolg man with fuzzy ears that his children inherited, and smelled of petrichor and pine.

He was a kind man and loving husband who supported his wife and wasn't afraid to be at risk if that meant helping her.

During the first century of the Calamity Amaris met Trist, a human woman, and they got married, having two children together, Haylie and Topher.
